snippet.title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Kena: Bridge of Spirits comes to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2026! 

Kena: Bridge of Spirits  is a story-driven, action adventure combining exploration with fast-paced combat. Untangle the past as Kena, a young Spirit Guide in search of the sacred Mountain Shrine. Free the spirits trapped in a forgotten village with the help of the Rot, her adorable (yet powerful) spirit companions. 

The Nintendo Switch 2 version includes the Anniversary DLC, featuring Charmstones, Spirit Guide Trials, Kena Outfits, accessibility features, and New Game+, letting players experience Kena’s journey again with all their unlocked abilities and upgrades. 

#NintendoSwitch2 #KenaBridgeofSpirits
